title: Vocalic-Spaces: Python reproduction package for "A mathematical model of the vowel space" (arXiv:2111.00868v3)
description:
Complete, self-contained Python code reproducing the simulations, figures, tables and multimedia files of the research article A mathematical model of the vowel space (F. Berthommier, arXiv:2111.00868v3, JASA-Express Letters submission).

Contents:

  • vsmodel – Python translation of the ICP/GIPSA-lab transmission-line model of the vocal tract (P. Badin: formant computation with Fant 1960 losses and wall vibration, complex-plane pole search), of the three-phase mixing and coordination functions (generic model, DRM 4-tube model, Fant 4-parameter model), and of the LPC vowel resynthesis chain (L. Girin: Rosenberg glottal source, Levinson/LPC lattice);
  • scripts – one script per figure (Figures 1–7), Monte-Carlo simulations in conditions C1/C2, multimedia regeneration (Mm. 1–6: vowel sounds and area-function movies), strict verification of the paper content and quantitative validation against the compiled MATLAB reference (formants within ~1 Hz, Fourier coefficients at machine precision);
  • data – MATLAB reference data converted to .npz and regenerated data;
  • docs – didactic introduction to the theory (US English);
  • paper – open-access two-column LaTeX edition of the article (free template) and the arXiv submission package;
  • matlab_supplement – the original MATLAB supplement scripts with their reference data.

Authorship: Frédéric Berthommier (article, simulations, coordination-function models, Python translation and packaging); Pierre Badin (transmission-line model of the vocal tract, original MATLAB codes); Laurent Girin (glottal source and LPC vowel resynthesis, original MATLAB codes).
